_comment: California's certified ballot for the cycle, hand-entered from the Secretary of State's Certified List of Candidates (federal and state races) and each county registrar's candidate list (county races). elections.py lays these over the FEC's registrations: a race here replaces the FEC race with the same id, and state and county races are added. Candidate ids are FEC ids where the candidate has one.
source: California Secretary of State, Certified List of Candidates for the November 3, 2026 General Election (Aug 27, 2026) for federal and state races; FEC candidate master for incumbency and filing links; county registrars' candidate lists for county races

level_notes.state: From the Secretary of State's certified list; includes judicial retention questions
level_notes.county: Board of Supervisors contests on the November ballot, from each county registrar's candidate list; seats decided outright in the June 2 primary are not listed
